cases.disposition_reason: The host start chooses the parent row. choose_cursor in src/widgets/file_browser.rs treats list cursor 0 as the cwd, and fixtures.rs sets HOME to /Users/alexey and cwd to /Users/alexey/src/payments-platform. Step 2 paints Same path and that path. Esc returns to step 1, and Esc again is rewind in src/bin/jackin/screens/prelude.rs, status Cancelled · nothing created, with no new workspace. The git start uses vim_keymap FileCmd::Url. The label is Git URL. A URL that contains no github() full_name paints Could not resolve from file_browser in src/bin/jackin/screens/modals.rs. https://github.com/chainargos/payments-platform resolves. ChoiceDialog::width(58) in prelude.rs cuts the source line before · git. The painted line keeps the URL prefix, and Default shows /work/payments-platform. The radio starts on Back's neighbor, not on the Back button. Down selects Edit destination… and Enter opens New workspace · step 3 of 5 · Edit destination. Esc returns to Destination, Enter opens Edit again, and Enter with the absolute path opens Working dir. edit_used makes Workdir Esc return to Edit. Name Esc returns to Workdir. The name field begins as the destination basename and is already editing. Enter submits payments-platform. validate_name paints A workspace named payments-platform already exists and stays on step 5. That open error is the checkpoint, shot at 120×40 and then at 80×24 before the terminal returns to 120×40. A name containing / paints Name cannot contain / and stays on step 5. payments-lab activates Create, dialog action index 1. create sets Workspace payments-lab · review and save in the editor and does not write the file. Ctrl+S calls open_preview in src/bin/jackin/screens/editor.rs. is_create is true, so the title is Create workspace. blockers in src/bin/jackin/screens/config.rs is empty, so the confirm label is Save, and Dialog::facts focuses Cancel. The saved status is absent on that preview. start_save schedules 900 ms. The wall clock reaches Workspace payments-lab saved. The manager lists payments-lab plus the original four names. Reopen focuses the tab strip. ] shows the Mounts row. column_widths leaves the Source cell short of the full URL, and the painted prefix is https://github.com/chainargos/payments-platfo.
cases.action_sequence: Start from a host directory and from Git. Visit Source, Destination, Edit, Workdir, and Name. Go Back and Cancel at each boundary. Enter an invalid and a duplicate name. Finish one valid prelude.
cases.expected_results: Cancel adds no workspace. The Editor shows the pending values. Save then reopen shows those values.
